articles.summary: Funding provided through the Bank's Community Development Partnership Program ISELIN, N.J., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Provident Bank , a leading New Jersey-based financial institution, announced today that it has awarded $83,000 in grants to ten local non-profit organizations through its Community Development Partnership Program. The grants will advance financial literacy education, affordable housing, homeownership, and help meet the credit needs of the communities served. The Community Development Partnership Program builds on Provident Bank’s long record of working alongside non-profits to strengthen the communities it serves and foster lasting economic prosperity. Combined, the recipients of these major grants received a total of $83,000. The local non-profit organizations include: Central Jersey Housing Resource Center: Supports households facing challenges by helping them find safe, affordable housing that meets their needs. articles.title: Provident Bank Announces $83,000 in Grants to Ten New Jersey Non-Profit Organizations

articles.summary: Accomplished Wealth Management Executive Brings More Than Two Decades of Experience in Business Development, Relationship Management and Strategic Growth ISELIN, N.J., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Beacon Trust , a wholly owned subsidiary of Provident Bank, announced today that Tristan Harding has joined the company as Managing Director, Head of Relationship Management and Growth. In this role, Mr. Harding will lead Beacon Trust's growth strategy, business development and relationship management efforts, with a focus on expanding its client base, deepening existing relationships and driving long-term, sustainable growth. Reporting to Anna Vitelli, Executive Vice President, Chief Wealth Officer of Provident Bank and President of Beacon Trust, he will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to increase assets under management, grow revenue, strengthen client retention and enhance the overall client experience.
